evidence.reason: This is doldecomp's sole ordinary #if MUST_MATCH site. The nonmatching build intentionally leaves MUST_MATCH undefined so this expression becomes zero while 727 #ifdef MUST_MATCH sites remain disabled.
GCC 11 diagnoses an object-size overflow in unselected inventory code; closure selection and exact section auditing remain fail-closed.
GCC 11 loses the x130 Locked-bit invariant across ECB loader calls and does not recognize the external CollDataInit zero-initialization contract.

The original DOL zero-extends the table byte, compares the resulting 0..255 word with -1, and retains the source branch. The equality is unreachable, so GCC's type-limits warning describes original behavior rather than a host semantic mismatch.

The original DOL zero-extends the Kirby effect-table byte and compares the resulting 0..255 word with -1 before the effect load. The equality is unreachable, so GCC's type-limits warning describes original behavior rather than a host semantic mismatch.

Both original DOL functions mask the collision word to the 0x6000 ceiling bits and compare that result with 1, so the vertical-velocity reset branch is unreachable. GCC's tautological-comparison warning describes the shipped behavior and is isolated to this source.

provider_exclusions.reason: THP movie texture allocation and GX upload are outside the headless competitive simulator; excluding this unit also prevents its host-only GXTexObj layout from weakening gameplay ABI assertions.
